"templateId": "367c4dff-ce56-5c23-898d-102c55a40595",
"title": "Open New Client Account",
"text": "Use this workflow to collect account‑opening requirements, prepare documentation, coordinate signatures, and confirm funding instructions for a new account. Verify the requested account registration, investment objective, tax considerations, and custodian requirements before submitting. The joint taxable account for Nora Thimblefern and Caleb Thimblefern will be funded from excess cash reserves and ownership and risk profile information will be collected before paperwork is prepared.",
"priority": "medium",
"dueDate": "2025-08-05",
"assigneeId": null,
"subTasks": [
{
"title": "Gather account opening details",
"text": "Collect required registration type, ownership details, beneficiary or authorized-party information if applicable, tax identification documentation status, risk profile, and intended funding source using firm-approved intake materials.",
"priority": "medium",
"assigneeId": null
},
{
"title": "Prepare and review application package",
"text": "Complete the custodian or platform forms, advisory agreement updates, fee schedule, disclosure delivery record, and any transfer or funding paperwork. Check for missing signatures, inconsistent names, and incomplete suitability information.",
"priority": "medium",
"assigneeId": "7b1c238f-c077-58f3-abf7-cfef829c2abc"
},
{
"title": "Coordinate signatures and submission",
"text": "Send the application package through the approved signature process, track completion, and submit to the custodian or operations platform after verifying all required fields are complete.",
"priority": "medium",
"assigneeId": null
},
{
"title": "Confirm account setup and funding readiness",
"text": "Verify that the account is established, document the account title and registration, confirm funding or transfer instructions are ready, and notify the advisor that the account is available for investment review.",
"priority": "medium",
"assigneeId": null
}
],
"evidence": "They agreed by 2025-08-05 to start intake for a new joint taxable account funded from excess cash reserve, with ownership and risk profile information to be collected before paperwork is prepared."
},
{
"templateId": "652157be-e8e6-5f89-b001-6e15103f7c88",
"title": "Collect Benefits Enrollment Information",
"text": "Complete the following placeholders before reviewing benefit enrollment choices:\n\nEmployee or participant name: Nora Thimblefern\nEmployer or plan sponsor: Amber Teapot Systems\nEnrollment event type: QUALIFYING LIFE EVENT\nCoverage effective period: [RELATIVE OR PLAN YEAR PERIOD]\nAvailable medical options: [PLAN OPTIONS]\nAvailable dental and vision options: [PLAN OPTIONS]\nHealth savings or flexible spending account eligibility: [HSA / FSA DETAILS]\nEmployer retirement plan election status: [401(k), 403(b), OR OTHER PLAN DETAILS]\nCurrent contribution percentage or amount: [CURRENT ELECTION]\nProposed contribution percentage or amount: [PROPOSED ELECTION]\nEmployer match formula: [MATCH DETAILS]\nBeneficiary update needed: [YES / NO / UNKNOWN]\nDocuments to request: [BENEFITS GUIDE, RATE SHEET, PLAN SUMMARY, BENEFICIARY FORM, OTHER]\nQuestions for advisor review: [OPEN QUESTIONS]",
"priority": "medium",
"dueDate": "2025-08-09",
"assigneeId": null,
"subTasks": [],
"evidence": "Employer benefit elections remain needed by 2025-08-09 because Nora reported the marriage is a qualifying event and the couple has not decided whether Caleb should move to Nora’s medical plan or keep separate coverage."
},
{
"templateId": null,
"title": "Document household intentions for beneficiary updates",
"text": "Document Nora Thimblefern and Caleb Thimblefern's current household intentions before updating beneficiary and transfer‑on‑death forms for the IRA, 401(k) and taxable brokerage accounts.",
"priority": null,
"dueDate": "2025-08-15",
"assigneeId": null,
"subTasks": [],
"evidence": "They agreed by 2025-08-15 to document current household intentions before updating beneficiary and transfer-on-death forms, after a review found Nora’s IRA, 401(k), and taxable account records still list pre-marriage beneficiaries or no contingent beneficiary."
},
{
"templateId": null,
"title": "Obtain proof of marriage for custodian",
"text": "Obtain a certified marriage certificate for Nora Thimblefern and Caleb Thimblefern to satisfy the custodian's name and household registration update requirements.",
"priority": null,
"dueDate": "2025-08-01",
"assigneeId": null,
"subTasks": [],

},
{
